population.note: Donor measurement depth is highly imbalanced. No minimum donor-cell threshold is invented by this preflight; network donor-stability methods must report sensitivity to low-n donors prospectively.

implications: The submitted peak matrix has broad ATAC support in the development microglia: 149,590/150,614 peaks are observed in at least one selected nucleus.
RNA feature support is sparser: 25,630/36,601 genes are observed at least once, and 12,848 are observed in at least 1% of development nuclei.
Donor recurrence provides a natural stability dimension but must not be converted into an outcome-tuned cutoff.
Two low-n donors make leave-one-donor-out and donor-bootstrap reporting especially important; nuclei count must not be mistaken for biological replication.
This preflight does not choose TFs, peaks, eRegulons, donor thresholds, or network parameters.
